subject: Vendor procurement kickoff — multi-team availability & reschedule notes

Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff for Redwood POC — availability

Hi Sean / Marissa —

Thanks for the materials you shared in the portal. Procurement at BlueBridge would like to schedule the formal kickoff next week so we can align timelines and get the PO process started. Key attendees we need on our side:
- Taylor Reed (Data Platform lead)
- Anika Sharma (Procurement)
- Rajiv Menon (third-party security assessor, CloudAssure)

Our constraints: we have an internal review on Thursday morning and Anika is out Friday. Can you propose 3 slots that include an evening PST time (to accommodate the SE) and a morning ET time for us? Also confirm whether you can circulate a short agenda and an evidence matrix ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,

Thanks Taylor — super helpful context. Suggested slots (all windows include 45–60 min for procurement + security Q/A):
1) Mon 30 Nov — 5:30pm PST / Tue 1 Dec — 8:30pm EST (evening SE okay?)
2) Tue 1 Dec — 9:00am PST / 12:00pm EST (midday on your side)
3) Wed 2 Dec — 7:30pm PST / Thu 3 Dec — 10:30pm EST (less preferred)

Marissa (AE) and Ben (Customer Success) will lead the PO steps; Karthik (Solutions Engineer) will cover architecture and Rajiv's security checklist. Monica (Onboarding Lead) will own next-step scheduling if we lock a date.

Per your ask, I attached a short kickoff agenda and the current POC plan + procurement questionnaire. I can also produce a redlined evidence matrix by EOD Friday if Rajiv shares any specific control templates.

I'll leave this to you — pick a slot and we will fire a calendar invite with the agenda and an ics.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — the windows look workable. Two notes:
- Anika out Fri (as mentioned) — we prefer Mon 30 Nov at 5:30pm PST if Karthik can do it. That gives us time to run this through our internal review on Thu.
- Rajiv flagged that he wants the security evidence matrix attached to the invite; can you include a one-page summary of data handling and retention?

If you send the calendar invite with the agenda and attachments, procurement will confirm and I will loop Legal if anything needs redlining.
